item.liberthia.white_matter_pendant.desc: A refined sliver of white matter — stabilizes all matters around the wearer.
tooltip.liberthia.yellow_matter_sword.de: Channels unstable emotions into a focused beam.
tooltip.liberthia.yellow_matter_sword.da: Damage increases by +10 for each second channeled.
tooltip.liberthia.yellow_matter_sword.in: Taking damage while channeling breaks the flow.
entity.liberthia.dark_consciousness.whis: I was born from your mistake.
The clarity only made me stronger.
I remember the moment of fusion. Do you?
Two minds became one. And neither is yours.
entity.liberthia.eye_of_horus.gaze1: It sees you. It has always seen you.
entity.liberthia.eye_of_horus.gaze2: Do not look directly at it.
chat.liberthia.attraction1: Something tells you to stay... it feels right here.
chat.liberthia.attraction2: Why would you leave? Everything you need is here.
chat.liberthia.attraction3: Your legs feel heavy. The warmth is inviting.
chat.liberthia.horus_trauma: The memories of Horus flood back. The Eye. The darkness. The screams.
chat.liberthia.horus_flashback: You see it again — the Eye, watching from the void...
chat.liberthia.equilibrium_use: The fragment resonates... balance flows through you.
item.liberthia.gravity_trap.desc1: Anchors a player with gravitational force
chat.liberthia.gravity_trapped: A black hole anchors you in place! You cannot escape!
chat.liberthia.gravity_released: The gravitational pull fades... you are free.
chat.liberthia.gravity_dimension_pull: The singularity tears at you across dimensions!
chat.liberthia.gravity_snap_back: The black hole snaps you back violently!
item.liberthia.gravity_anchor.desc1: Grounds all nearby players to the earth
item.liberthia.gravity_anchor.desc2: The sky is no longer an option.
chat.liberthia.grounded: An immense force crushes you to the ground!
chat.liberthia.anchor_released: The gravitational pressure fades... you can move again.
item.liberthia.freeze_staff.desc1: Completely freezes a player in time
chat.liberthia.frozen: You are frozen solid! You cannot move or act!
chat.liberthia.thawed: The ice shatters... you can move again.
chat.liberthia.exec_no_stick: You need a Marking Stick in inventory!
chat.liberthia.exec_no_pos: Marking Stick has no TP position set!
chat.liberthia.exec_tped: You were teleported by the Execution Stick!
item.liberthia.blood_syringe.tooltip.emp: §7Empty — use on a living being to extract.
item.liberthia.blood_teleport_pearl.tool: §cCosts 4 HP. Teleports you to the impact point.
item.liberthia.purging_pendant.tooltip: §eConsumes Sanguine Essence to cleanse harmful effects.
item.liberthia.veiling_orb.tooltip: §8Throws a dome of blindness and darkness on impact.
item.liberthia.mind_splinter_dart.toolti: §dDrives the target mad: confusion, fatigue, weakness.
item.liberthia.lightning_node.tooltip: §eEvolves and strikes nearby foes with real lightning.
item.liberthia.screaming_soul.tooltip: §8Looking at it inflicts Darkness and Wither.
item.liberthia.magnetic_pylon.tooltip: §5Pulls creatures and items; crushes those who get close.
item.liberthia.lightning_grenade.tooltip: §eThrow to call down lightning and mark foes.
item.liberthia.burning_gem.tooltip: §cExplodes in flames: 3x3 fire and ignite damage.
item.liberthia.frost_flask.tooltip: §bFreezes water, heavy slowness and ice damage in area.
item.liberthia.eye_of_decay.tooltip: §2Corrupts the ground around it; consumes durability.
item.liberthia.withered_totem.tooltip: §8At low health: Resistance II + Regen and Wither on nearby foes.
item.liberthia.growth_rod.tooltip: §aIncreases target scale by 0.1 (requires a scale mod).
item.liberthia.shrink_rod.tooltip: §dDecreases target scale by 0.1 (requires a scale mod).
item.liberthia.command_pylon.tooltip: §5Programmable block: imprint with Tablet and trigger via redstone.
item.liberthia.script_tablet.tooltip: §dReal scripting: if/else, while, repeat, let, wait, run, say.
item.liberthia.pipe_filter_not.desc: Right-click an Item Pipe face to toggle filter mode WHITELIST (only listed) ↔ BLACKLIST (everything but listed).
item.liberthia.pipe_filter.desc: Right-click an Item Pipe face to FORCE WHITELIST mode. Sibling of Pipe NOT Filter — useful for UNDO.
block.liberthia.host_plush.desc: Decorative plushie of the Liberthia host. Place on floor, rotates with placement direction, and can be waterlogged.
item.liberthia.refined_containment_penda: Pendant forged around a purified Clear Matter crystal. Pauses matter gain from all ambient sources without infecting the wearer.
item.liberthia.refined_containment_glove: Leather glove lined with purified Clear Matter. Blocks matter gain from direct hand contact.
item.liberthia.dark_matter_pendant.desc: Blocks ambient Dark Matter gain. Wears faster the more DM you carry.
item.liberthia.clear_matter_pendant.desc: Blocks ambient Clear Matter gain. Wears faster the more WM you carry.
item.liberthia.yellow_matter_pendant.des: Blocks ambient Yellow Matter gain. Wears faster the more YM you carry.
item.liberthia.reliquia_protecao_astaron: Forged by Astaron from one of his fragmentations. Protects against fatal damage by teleporting the bearer.
item.liberthia.astaron_access_key.desc: Right-click to return to the saved location. Bound — only the owner can use it.
item.liberthia.pes_queimantes_astaron.de: Pure magma feet forged by Astaron. Speed III, trails of fire.
item.liberthia.flame_key.desc: Toggles the fire of the Burning Feet.
item.liberthia.botas_mercuriais.desc: Alchemical wings — allow free flight. Drains while flying or on hits.
